1.zh: 奉　神旨意，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗，写信给在以弗所的圣徒，就是在基督耶稣里有忠心的人。
1.en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

1.zh: 愿恩惠、平安从　神我们的父和主耶稣基督归与你们！
1.en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 愿颂赞归与我们主耶稣基督的父　神！他在基督里曾赐给我们天上各样属灵的福气：
1.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

1.zh: 就如　神从创立世界以前，在基督里拣选了我们，使我们在他面前成为圣洁，无有瑕疵；
1.en: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

1.zh: 又因爱我们，就按着自己的意旨所喜悦的，预定我们借着耶稣基督得儿子的名分，
1.en: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

1.zh: 使他荣耀的恩典得着称赞；这恩典是他在爱子里所赐给我们的。
1.en: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

1.zh: 我们借这爱子的血得蒙救赎，过犯得以赦免，乃是照他丰富的恩典。
1.en: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

1.zh: 这恩典是　神用诸般智慧聪明，充充足足赏给我们的；
1.en: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

1.zh: 都是照他自己所预定的美意，叫我们知道他旨意的奥秘，
1.en: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

1.zh: 要照所安排的，在日期满足的时候，使天上、地上、一切所有的都在基督里面同归于一。
1.en: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

1.zh: 我们也在他里面得了基业；这原是那位随己意行、做万事的，照着他旨意所预定的，
1.en: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

1.zh: 叫他的荣耀从我们这首先在基督里有盼望的人可以得着称赞。
1.en: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

1.zh: 你们既听见真理的道，就是那叫你们得救的福音，也[信了]基督，既然信他，就受了所应许的圣灵为印记。
1.en: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

1.zh: 这圣灵是我们得基业的凭据，直等到　[神]之民被赎，使他的荣耀得着称赞。
1.en: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

1.zh: 因此，我既听见你们信从主耶稣，亲爱众圣徒，
1.en: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,

1.zh: 就为你们不住地感谢　神。祷告的时候，常提到你们，
1.en: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

1.zh: 求我们主耶稣基督的　神，荣耀的父，将那赐人智慧和启示的灵赏给你们，使你们真知道他，
1.en: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,

1.zh: 并且照明你们心中的眼睛，使你们知道他的恩召有何等指望，他在圣徒中得的基业有何等丰盛的荣耀；
1.en: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

1.zh: 并[知道]他向我们这信的人所显的能力是何等浩大，
1.en: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

1.zh: 就是照他在基督身上所运行的大能大力，使他从死里复活，叫他在天上坐在自己的右边，
1.en: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

1.zh: 远超过一切执政的、掌权的、有能的、主治的，和一切有名的；不但是今世的，连来世的也都超过了。
1.en: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

1.zh: 又将万有服在他的脚下，使他为教会作万有之首。
1.en: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

1.zh: 教会是他的身体，是那充满万有者所充满的。
1.en: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

2.zh: 你们死在过犯罪恶之中，[他叫你们活过来]。
2.en: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

2.zh: 那时，你们在其中行事为人，随从今世的风俗，顺服空中掌权者的首领，就是现今在悖逆之子心中运行的[邪]灵。
2.en: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.

2.zh: 我们从前也都在他们中间，放纵肉体的私欲，随着肉体和心中所喜好的去行，本为可怒之子，和别人一样。
2.en: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

2.zh: 然而，　神既有丰富的怜悯，因他爱我们的大爱，
2.en: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

2.zh: 当我们死在过犯中的时候，便叫我们与基督一同活过来。你们得救是本乎恩。
2.en: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—

2.zh: 他又叫我们与基督耶稣一同复活，一同坐在天上，
2.en: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

2.zh: 要将他极丰富的恩典，就是他在基督耶稣里向我们所施的恩慈，显明给后来的世代看。
2.en: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

2.zh: 你们得救是本乎恩，也因着信；这并不是出于自己，乃是　神所赐的；
2.en: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

2.zh: 也不是出于行为，免得有人自夸。
2.en: not of works, that no one would boast.

2.zh: 我们原是他的工作，在基督耶稣里造成的，为要叫我们行善，就是　神所预备叫我们行的。
2.en: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

2.zh: 所以你们应当记念：你们从前按肉体是外邦人，是称为没受割礼的；这名原是那些凭人手在肉身上称为受割礼之人所起的。
2.en: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),

2.zh: 那时，你们与基督无关，在以色列国民以外，在所应许的诸约上是局外人，并且[活]在世上没有指望，没有　神。
2.en: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

2.zh: 你们从前远离　[神]的人，如今却在基督耶稣里，靠着他的血，已经得亲近了。
2.en: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

2.zh: 因他使我们和睦，将两下合而为一，拆毁了中间隔断的墙；
2.en: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,

2.zh: 而且以自己的身体废掉冤仇，就是那[记]在律法上的规条，为要将两下借着自己造成一个新人，[如此]便成就了和睦。
2.en: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,

2.zh: 既在十字架上灭了冤仇，便借这十字架使两下归为一体，与　神和好了，
2.en: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.

2.zh: 并且来传和平的福音给你们远处的人，也给那近处的人。
2.en: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

2.zh: 因为我们两下借着他被一个[圣]灵所感，得以进到父面前。
2.en: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

2.zh: 这样，你们不再作外人和客旅，是与圣徒同国，是　神家里的人了；
2.en: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,

2.zh: 并且被建造在使徒和先知的根基上，有基督耶稣自己为房角石，
2.en: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

2.zh: 各房靠他联络得合式，渐渐成为主的圣殿。
2.en: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

2.zh: 你们也靠他同被建造，成为　神借着圣灵居住的所在。
2.en: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

3.zh: 因此，我—保罗为你们外邦人作了基督耶稣被囚的，[替你们祈祷]。
3.en: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

3.zh: 谅必你们曾听见　神赐恩给我，将关切你们的职分托付我，
3.en: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,

3.zh: 用启示使我知道[福音的]奥秘，正如我以前略略写过的。
3.en: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

3.zh: 你们念了，就能晓得我深知基督的奥秘。
3.en: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

3.zh: 这奥秘在以前的世代没有叫人知道，像如今借着圣灵启示他的圣使徒和先知一样。
3.en: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

3.zh: [这奥秘]就是外邦人在基督耶稣里，借着福音，得以同为后嗣，同为一体，同蒙应许。
3.en: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

3.zh: 我作了这福音的执事，是照　神的恩赐，这恩赐是照他运行的大能赐给我的。
3.en: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

3.zh: 我本来比众圣徒中最小的还小，然而他还赐我这恩典，叫我把基督那测不透的丰富传给外邦人，
3.en: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

3.zh: 又使众人都明白，这历代以来隐藏在创造万物之　神里的奥秘是如何安排的，
3.en: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,

3.zh: 为要借着教会使天上执政的、掌权的，现在得知　神百般的智慧。
3.en: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

3.zh: 这是照　神从万世以前，在我们主基督耶稣里所定的旨意。
3.en: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

3.zh: 我们因信耶稣，就在他里面放胆无惧，笃信不疑地来到　神面前。
3.en: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

3.zh: 所以，我求你们不要因我为你们所受的患难丧胆，这原是你们的荣耀。
3.en: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

3.zh: 因此，我在父面前屈膝，（
3.en: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

3.zh: 天上地上的各家，都是从他得名。）
3.en: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

3.zh: 求他按着他丰盛的荣耀，借着他的灵，叫你们心里的力量刚强起来，
3.en: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

3.zh: 使基督因你们的信，住在你们心里，叫你们的爱心有根有基，
3.en: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

3.zh: 能以和众圣徒一同明白基督的爱是何等长阔高深，
3.en: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

3.zh: 并知道这爱是过于人所能测度的，便叫　神一切所充满的，充满了你们。
3.en: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

3.zh: 神能照着运行在我们心里的大力充充足足地成就一切，超过我们所求所想的。
3.en: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

3.zh: 但愿他在教会中，并在基督耶稣里，得着荣耀，直到世世代代，永永远远。阿们！
3.en: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

4.zh: 我为主被囚的劝你们：既然蒙召，行事为人就当与蒙召的恩相称。
4.en: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

4.zh: 凡事谦虚、温柔、忍耐，用爱心互相宽容，
4.en: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

4.zh: 用和平彼此联络，竭力保守[圣]灵所赐合而为一的心。
4.en: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

4.zh: 身体只有一个，[圣]灵只有一个，正如你们蒙召同有一个指望。
4.en: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

4.zh: 一主，一信，一洗，
4.en: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

4.zh: 一　神，就是众人的父，超乎众人之上，贯乎众人之中，也住在众人之内。
4.en: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

4.zh: 我们各人蒙恩，都是照基督所量给各人的恩赐。
4.en: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

4.zh: 所以[经上]说： 他升上高天的时候，掳掠了仇敌， 将各样的恩赐赏给人。 （
4.en: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”

4.zh: 既说升上，岂不是先降在地下吗？
4.en: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

4.zh: 那降下的，就是远升诸天之上要充满万有的。）
4.en: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

4.zh: 他所赐的，有使徒，有先知，有传福音的，有牧师和教师，
4.en: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;

4.zh: 为要成全圣徒，各尽其职，建立基督的身体，
4.en: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,

4.zh: 直等到我们众人在真道上同归于一，认识　神的儿子，得以长大成人，满有基督长成的身量，
4.en: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

4.zh: 使我们不再作小孩子，中了人的诡计和欺骗的法术，被一切异教之风摇动，飘来飘去，就随从各样的异端；
4.en: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

4.zh: 惟用爱心说诚实话，凡事长进，连于元首基督，
4.en: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,

4.zh: 全身都靠他联络得合式，百节各按各职，照着各体的功用彼此相助，便叫身体渐渐增长，在爱中建立自己。
4.en: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

4.zh: 所以我说，且在主里确实地说，你们行事不要再像外邦人存虚妄的心行事。
4.en: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

4.zh: 他们心地昏昧，与　神所赐的生命隔绝了，都因自己无知，心里刚硬；
4.en: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.

4.zh: 良心既然丧尽，就放纵私欲，贪行种种的污秽。
4.en: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

4.zh: 你们学了基督，却不是这样。
4.en: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,

4.zh: 如果你们听过他的道，领了他的教，学了他的真理，
4.en: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

4.zh: 就要脱去你们从前行为上的旧人，这旧人是因私欲的迷惑渐渐变坏的；
4.en: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

4.zh: 又要将你们的心志改换一新，
4.en: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

4.zh: 并且穿上新人；这新人是照着　神[的形象]造的，有真理的仁义和圣洁。
4.en: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

4.zh: 所以，你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话，因为我们是互相为肢体。
4.en: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

4.zh: 生气却不要犯罪；不可含怒到日落，
4.en: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

4.zh: 也不可给魔鬼留地步。
4.en: and don’t give place to the devil.

4.zh: 从前偷窃的，不要再偷；总要劳力，亲手做正经事，就可有[余]分给那缺少的人。
4.en: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

4.zh: 污秽的言语一句不可出口，只要随事说造就人的好话，叫听见的人得益处。
4.en: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

4.zh: 不要叫　神的圣灵担忧；你们原是受了他的印记，等候得赎的日子来到。
4.en: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

4.zh: 一切苦毒、恼恨、忿怒、嚷闹、毁谤，并一切的恶毒，都当从你们中间除掉；
4.en: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

4.zh: 并要以恩慈相待，存怜悯的心，彼此饶恕，正如　神在基督里饶恕了你们一样。
4.en: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

5.zh: 所以，你们该效法　神，好像蒙慈爱的儿女一样。
5.en: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

5.zh: 也要凭爱心行事，正如基督爱我们，为我们舍了自己，当作馨香的供物和祭物，献与　神。
5.en: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

5.zh: 至于淫乱并一切污秽，或是贪婪，在你们中间连提都不可，方合圣徒的体统。
5.en: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

5.zh: 淫词、妄语，和戏笑的话都不相宜；总要说感谢的话。
5.en: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

5.zh: 因为你们确实地知道，无论是淫乱的，是污秽的，是有贪心的，在基督和　神的国里都是无分的。有贪心的，就与拜偶像的一样。
5.en: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

5.zh: 不要被人虚浮的话欺哄；因这些事，　神的忿怒必临到那悖逆之子。
5.en: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

5.zh: 所以，你们不要与他们同伙。
5.en: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

5.zh: 从前你们是暗昧的，但如今在主里面是光明的，行事为人就当像光明的子女。
5.en: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

5.zh: 光明所结的果子就是一切良善、公义、诚实。
5.en: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

5.zh: 总要察验何为主所喜悦的事。
5.en: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

5.zh: 那暗昧无益的事，不要与人同行，倒要责备[行这事的人]；
5.en: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

5.zh: 因为他们暗中所行的，就是提起来也是可耻的。
5.en: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

5.zh: 凡事受了责备，就被光显明出来，因为一切能显明的就是光。
5.en: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

5.zh: 所以[主]说： 你这睡着的人当醒过来， 从死里复活！ 基督就要光照你了。
5.en: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

5.zh: 你们要谨慎行事，不要像愚昧人，当像智慧人。
5.en: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

5.zh: 要爱惜光阴，因为现今的世代邪恶。
5.en: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

5.zh: 不要作糊涂人，要明白主的旨意如何。
5.en: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

5.zh: 不要醉酒，酒能使人放荡；乃要被[圣]灵充满。
5.en: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

5.zh: 当用诗章、颂词、灵歌彼此对说，口唱心和地赞美主。
5.en: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

5.zh: 凡事要奉我们主耶稣基督的名常常感谢父　神。
5.en: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

5.zh: 又当存敬畏基督的心，彼此顺服。
5.en: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

5.zh: 你们作妻子的，[当顺服]自己的丈夫，如同[顺服]主。
5.en: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

5.zh: 因为丈夫是妻子的头，如同基督是教会的头；他又是[教会]全体的救主。
5.en: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

5.zh: 教会怎样顺服基督，妻子也要怎样凡事顺服丈夫。
5.en: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

5.zh: 你们作丈夫的，要爱你们的妻子，正如基督爱教会，为教会舍己。
5.en: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

5.zh: 要用水借着道把教会洗净，成为圣洁，
5.en: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

5.zh: 可以献给自己，作个荣耀的教会，毫无玷污、皱纹等类的病，乃是圣洁没有瑕疵的。
5.en: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

5.zh: 丈夫也当照样爱妻子，如同爱自己的身子；爱妻子便是爱自己了。
5.en: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

5.zh: 从来没有人恨恶自己的身子，总是保养顾惜，正像基督待教会一样，
5.en: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

5.zh: 因我们是他身上的肢体。
5.en: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

5.zh: 为这个缘故，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。
5.en: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”

5.zh: 这是极大的奥秘，但我是指着基督和教会说的。
5.en: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

5.zh: 然而，你们各人都当爱妻子，如同爱自己一样。妻子也当敬重她的丈夫。
5.en: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

6.zh: 你们作儿女的，要在主里听从父母，这是理所当然的。
6.en: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

6.zh: 「要孝敬父母，使你得福，在世长寿。」这是第一条带应许的诫命。
6.en: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:
“that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”

6.zh: 你们作父亲的，不要惹儿女的气，只要照着主的教训和警戒养育他们。
6.en: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

6.zh: 你们作仆人的，要惧怕战兢，用诚实的心听从你们肉身的主人，好像听从基督一般。
6.en: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

6.zh: 不要只在眼前事奉，像是讨人喜欢的，要像基督的仆人，从心里遵行　神的旨意。
6.en: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

6.zh: 甘心事奉，好像服事主，不像服事人。
6.en: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

6.zh: 因为晓得各人所行的善事，不论是为奴的，是自主的，都必按所行的得主的赏赐。
6.en: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

6.zh: 你们作主人的，待仆人也是一理，不要威吓他们。因为知道，他们和你们同有一位主在天上；他并不偏待人。
6.en: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

6.zh: 我还有末了的话：你们要靠着主，倚赖他的大能大力作刚强的人。
6.en: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

6.zh: 要穿戴　神[所赐]的全副军装，就能抵挡魔鬼的诡计。
6.en: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

6.zh: 因我们并不是与属血气的争战，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔争战。
6.en: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

6.zh: 所以，要拿起　神[所赐]的全副军装，好在磨难的日子抵挡[仇敌]，并且成就了一切，还能站立得住。
6.en: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

6.zh: 所以要站稳了，用真理当作带子束腰，用公义当作护心镜遮胸，
6.en: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

6.zh: 又用平安的福音当作预备走路的鞋穿在脚上。
6.en: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

6.zh: 此外，又拿着信德当作盾牌，可以灭尽那恶者一切的火箭；
6.en: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

6.zh: 并戴上救恩的头盔，拿着[圣]灵的宝剑，就是　神的道；
6.en: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

6.zh: 靠着[圣]灵，随时多方祷告祈求；并要在此警醒不倦，为众圣徒祈求，
6.en: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.

6.zh: 也为我祈求，使我得着口才，能以放胆开口讲明福音的奥秘，
6.en: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

6.zh: （我为这福音的奥秘作了带锁链的使者，）并使我照着当尽的本分放胆讲论。
6.en: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

6.zh: 今有所亲爱、忠心事奉主的兄弟推基古，他要把我的事情，并我的景况如何全告诉你们，叫你们知道。
6.en: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.

6.zh: 我特意打发他到你们那里去，好叫你们知道我们的光景，又叫他安慰你们的心。
6.en: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.

6.zh: 愿平安、仁爱、信心从父　神和主耶稣基督归与弟兄们！
6.en: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

6.zh: 并愿所有诚心爱我们主耶稣基督的人都蒙恩惠！
6.en: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.
